mode_definitions.ANALOGY: some member of the class is exact on Tr and on the answers g.c of the registered relational instances whose group element g never appears in Tr
mode_definitions.EXTRAPOLATION: some member of the class is exact on Tr and on the registered subset X \ span(Tr), which must be nonempty
mode_definitions.INTERPOLATION: some member of the class is exact on span(Tr), the smallest subcube of X containing Tr
mode_definitions.MEMORIZATION: some member of the class is exact on Tr and scores exactly the base rate on X \ Tr
mode_definitions.PLANNING_INFERENCE: some member of the class is exact on Tr and on the registered targets that need a composition of at least two registered primitives, no single primitive sufficing
mode_definitions.REASONING: some member of the class is exact on Tr, on the entailments of the frozen Horn system whose shortest derivation has depth at least 2 and which are not members of Tr, and on their one-atom non-entailed neighbours
mode_definitions.SYSTEMATIC_GENERALIZATION: some member of the class is exact on Tr and on every recombination of block values occurring in Tr, including combinations absent from Tr

INTERPOLATION_holds_SYSTEMATIC_GENERALIZ.argument: exactness on the first mode's constraint set forces exactness on the second's, so no class can realize the first and fail the second
